residency_notes: OpenInference says prompts and responses are processed transiently and not retained after delivery. Its privacy policy says personal information is transferred to and processed in the United States; it does not publish model-execution regions.
prompt_training_notes: OpenInference says it does not retain prompt or response contents after delivery and does not use them to train or improve models.

sources.notes: First-party service site describing TPU-hosted large-model inference. No public direct API reference, model catalogue, base URL, or rate limits are published.
First-party zero-data-retention, no-training, and United States processing disclosures.
